positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed relational and time-series models for multi-tenant business logic and telemetry using PostgreSQL with TimescaleDB. Drove analytical queries with Continuous Aggregates, Materialization, Views, and Table-Valued Functions. Handled events with PL/pgSQL routines, database triggers, and LISTEN/NOTIFY mechanisms. 

- Containerized apps via Docker/Ansible, built resilient DB clusters, and set up ELK log monitoring.

- Designed & implemented a Go service for telemetry ingestion and processing. Engineered concurrent data pipelines using synchronization mechanisms for asynchronous data processing and in-memory caching. Implemented deterministic state machines to trigger reporting. Implemented an event-driven notification service to process and relay notifications. 

- Designed secure RESTful APIs via OpenAPI specifications for system administration, asset modeling, and data visualization. Modeled complex assets, discretionary access (DAC), and role-based access control (RBAC) sessions with trees and directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). Implemented stateful WebSocket connections integrated with user sessions to stream real-time data and provide live system views.

- Developed a mobile-responsive React application providing data visualization and interactive views. Managed complex, asynchronous client-side state for faceted resource search, dynamic pagination, API consumption, and stateful WebSocket streams for live views.

- Implemented a custom BLE GATT communication client for a proprietary hardware protocol and developed a cross-platform Flutter (Dart) application to enable live sensor monitoring and remote device configuration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Contributed to the search pipeline by implementing Elasticsearch data ingestion routines, configuring indices, and writing custom query classes to enforce strict data privacy constraints.

- Migrated a multi-process RPC server from Python 2.7 to 3.7 and Thrift from 0.9.1 to 0.10.0, validating the migration by authoring a 300-test pytest suite from scratch.

- Built the search vertical from design specifications, implementing infinite scroll to asynchronously fetch pages of data from the downstream Search API via the Rails SOA gateway. Expanded the vertical to support additional search experiences for users and brands.

- Developed full-stack dynamic faceted navigation, pairing complex client-side filter panels in React with Elasticsearch aggregations and filters on the backend.

- Instrumented search API paths and verticals with performance logging, metrics, and feature flags to enhance production monitoring and enable defensive feature rollouts.
